I've been back to the hospital three times, since it happened. Both the hospital, paramedics and 111, say my GP should at least see me in person and refer me for a CT scan. As all have said I could have post complications.
I have been having concussion issues, and headpain non stop since it happpened.
My GP refused to do a home visit, because  I am not a child or correctly housebound. Despite the fact I don't go out alone , due to my other medical condition which prevents me from going out unaccompanied.

I now have no idea if I have a bleed on the brain or pressure building up , due to the nature of the attack. GPs are NOT here to serve the normal general public. They are an only fans, friends and family private club. That the public can't  attend.

Yet when I go into the doctor's surgery, I witness people walking in off the street, asking for an appointment days in advance, and getting them without question.
This proves GPs have a two tier service.
It is shocking and should be
